name: To The Ends of The Earth

meta.note: Values validated against the Figma source of truth. The four biome tokens are marked pending final approval upstream.

tokens.name: fire-orange
tokens.usage: Primitive. Fire of the Holy Spirit, urgency, breakthrough. Never use it directly in a component — use the semantic tokens below.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Primitive. The earth, the soil, the darkness of unreached places.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Primitive. Gospel light piercing the darkness. Pure white belongs to the IDENTITY palette; in photography the white is Warm White #f4f3f1.

tokens.name: grey
tokens.usage: Primitive supporting neutral. 4.90:1 on black; only 3.03:1 on white — keep it on dark grounds.

tokens.name: brand-primary
tokens.usage: Brand layer. Maximum emphasis: CTAs, the wordmark accent, the icon's wing, HUD labels. Never a dominant background on a long layout.

tokens.name: brand-dark
tokens.usage: Brand layer. The default immersive background.

tokens.name: brand-light
tokens.usage: Brand layer. Editorial layouts and text on dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The page background in the current theme. Dark is the brand default; light is the editorial mode.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on `surface`. 14.85:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary and inactive text on `surface`. Passes 4.5:1 in the dark theme; in the light theme it sits at 3.03:1, so reserve it for large or non-essential text.

tokens.name: text-default
tokens.usage: Body text on a light background.

tokens.name: text-inverted
tokens.usage: Text on a dark surface.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Emphasis. Use sparingly: one word in a headline, one value in a table.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary: inactive navigation, labels on dark.

tokens.name: surface-dark
tokens.usage: Dark panels, immersive background, HUD.

tokens.name: surface-light
tokens.usage: Light and editorial layouts.

tokens.name: surface-accent
tokens.usage: CTA background, and nothing else. Never a resting surface.

tokens.name: icon-primary
tokens.usage: The TTE bird's orange wing, action icons.

tokens.name: icon-dark
tokens.usage: Icon on a light background.

tokens.name: icon-light
tokens.usage: Icon on a dark background.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Border and divider in the current theme. On dark, apply it at low opacity to make a hairline.

tokens.name: border-accent
tokens.usage: Active and branded borders. 4.64:1 on black — passes as a non-text element.

tokens.name: hud-text
tokens.usage: HUD data text. Always on dark.

tokens.name: hud-accent
tokens.usage: HUD labels and field names.

tokens.name: hud-background
tokens.usage: HUD panel background.

tokens.name: biome-desert
tokens.usage: Arid biome accent. PENDING FINAL APPROVAL. Secondary accent: it appears as a swatch, never as a fill and never as a rival to Fire Orange.

tokens.name: biome-arctic
tokens.usage: Frozen biome accent. PENDING FINAL APPROVAL. Same usage rule.

tokens.name: biome-city
tokens.usage: Urban biome accent. PENDING FINAL APPROVAL. Same usage rule.

tokens.name: biome-forest
tokens.usage: Tropical biome accent. PENDING FINAL APPROVAL. Same usage rule.

tokens.name: hope-channel-blue
tokens.usage: Hope Channel parent brand. Use only inside the co-brand lockup — never in a TTE component.

tokens.name: hope-channel-yellow
tokens.usage: Hope Channel parent brand. Same restriction.

styles.name: display-2xl
styles.usage: UPPERCASE. Campaign hero, the largest moment on the page.

styles.name: label-lg
styles.usage: UPPERCASE. Mobilize button label, default and lg sizes.

styles.name: mona-body
styles.usage: Sentence case. The documented EXCEPTION to the Mona Sans uppercase rule: use it for longer, editorial reading.
styles.sample: The gospel of Jesus will reach every people group on earth.

styles.name: mona-body-sm
styles.usage: Sentence case. The same exception, in editorial supporting text.
styles.sample: Prayer is delegated authority in the unseen realm.

styles.name: body-regular
styles.usage: Sentence case. The interface's standard body text.
styles.sample: A government can expel a missionary. It cannot stop a video.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: The statistic feels impossible. The theology says inevitable.

styles.name: body-xs
styles.usage: Sentence case. Fine print and footnotes.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE. Operate button label, badge and table header.

spacing.note: A 4px base scale. Use only these steps.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: Zero. Butts together elements that form a single piece.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon + label pairs, HUD fields.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Related elements; badge and chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Compact elements.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button and input padding; page margin on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: The single inset of the People Group Card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding and section separators.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero and container padding; page margin on tablet.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Breathing room between blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Layout gaps.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Wide breathing room.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Maximum gap, between large narrative blocks.

radius.note: Zero. The brand is angular and tactical. The one exception is the circular avatar.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Explicit. Every TTE component.

tokens.name: radius-default
tokens.usage: The system default. Button, input, card, badge, panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: THE ONE EXCEPTION: circular avatars and radio buttons. Nothing else.

shadow.note: A border is the default; a shadow only when the element floats above another plane.

tokens.name: elevation-sm
tokens.usage: Tooltips and dropdowns.

tokens.name: elevation-md
tokens.usage: Cards on a dark background.

tokens.name: elevation-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and overlays.

tokens.name: elevation-hud
tokens.usage: The HUD panel's orange glow. The signature.

sizing.note: One tokenized height governs every interactive control, so that default means the same thing everywhere.

tokens.name: sizing-control-sm
tokens.usage: Dense: HUD, tables, toolbars. The natural pairing for intent operate.

tokens.name: sizing-control-default
tokens.usage: THE SYSTEM DEFAULT. Button, Input and Select all size from here.

tokens.name: sizing-control-lg
tokens.usage: Hero CTAs. The natural pairing for intent mobilize.

tokens.name: border-width-thin
tokens.usage: HUD lines and dividers.

tokens.name: border-width-default
tokens.usage: Standard component border.

tokens.name: border-width-thick
tokens.usage: Active states and emphasis; the Mission Stat tick.

tokens.name: opacity-topographic
tokens.usage: The topographic texture behind any content. The canonical value — never at full opacity.

tokens.name: opacity-overlay-light
tokens.usage: Subtle background tint.

tokens.name: opacity-overlay-medium
tokens.usage: Overlay on an image, for legibility.

tokens.name: opacity-overlay-heavy
tokens.usage: Strong scrim, HUD background over a photograph.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control.
